title: cymbidium tabulare
intro: Cymbidium tabulare, commonly known as the Table Orchid, is a species of orchid native to the mountainous regions of Australia and New Guinea. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The therapeutic actions of Cymbidium tabulare are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties in in vitro studies. Further research is required to fully understand the effects of Cymbidium tabulare on human health.
